Karthus.combo: Once you have chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style. If you see a chance to secure a kill, activate R Highlander, then engage with Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. The durations of E Wuju Style and R Highlander do not decrease while you use Q Alpha Strike or W Meditate. Use W Meditate when Karthus's heavy damage is about to hit, then follow up with an empowered basic attack as soon as it ends.
Karthus.teamfight: Do not engage first. Wait out of sight until the enemy's immobilizing crowd control has been used. When you get an opening to take the first target without staying in Karthus E Defile for long, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in, then look for another target with R Highlander's takedown effect. Even if you kill Karthus, do not stay by his body; reposition immediately.
Karthus.phase: Karthus is vulnerable early because he has no mobility or immobilizing abilities, but Master Yi should prioritize farming until he learns R Highlander. Master Yi becomes strong in the mid to late game, when R Highlander helps him participate in takedowns and he has attack speed and penetration items. In the late game, engaging becomes difficult once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Karthus.build: Build attack speed and penetration items to increase your damage in the mid to late game. Karthus Q Lay Waste, E Defile, and R Requiem all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor. Avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain and spend less time inside E Defile before stacking more resistance.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance or immobilize you, so engage when you can reach him without stepping into Karthus W Wall of Pain. If its slow is a problem, activate Master Yi R Highlander to close the gap. If you kill Karthus after engaging, immediately move away from his body to avoid the damage left by Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing abilities, so when you get a chance to close the gap, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to get on him and follow up with basic attacks. Karthus has relatively low armor, so Master Yi's primary physical damage works well against him. Use Master Yi W Meditate to withstand Karthus's heavy damage, and move away from his body immediately if you kill him.
Karthus.laning: In the early game, Master Yi should focus on clearing jungle camps and building a lead. Invade the enemy jungle only after securing vision and confirming Karthus is on the opposite side.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals increased damage when it hits you alone, so walk out when you see the blast warning and, if possible, stand on top of an ally or minion. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces magic resistance and slows, so go around the wall. Even after killing Karthus, immediately move away from his body to avoid the Q Lay Waste and E Defile cast by Karthus P Death Defied.

Elise.laning: Farm the jungle and scale early, while securing vision to avoid giving Elise kills with her ganks. When Elise is out of sight, watch your lanes to make sure they aren’t pushed too far. Gank when an ally’s crowd control is ready or the enemy’s escape ability is down. Before entering the enemy jungle, confirm Elise is on the opposite side.
Elise.teamfight: Don’t engage first; wait out of vision for immobilizing crowd control such as Elise E Cocoon to be used. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and take down the first target; use the abilities that have refreshed from Master Yi R Highlander’s takedown effect on the next target. If there’s no opening in a face-to-face standoff, pressure a side lane and wait for the enemy to split up.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand damage from Elise’s main abilities. Also consider armor, since she deals basic attack damage too. If the healing from Elise P Spider Queen is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items and keep Grievous Wounds applied with basic attacks.
Elise.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you can confidently secure the kill. When Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite or Elise E Rappel is down and you can close the gap, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to get on her and follow up with basic attacks. After Elise E Cocoon is used, use Master Yi W Meditate when you take heavy damage, then resume basic attacks as soon as it ends.
Elise.escape: The moment after Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite is used is a chance to close the gap, so follow with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. If you’ve confirmed that both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel are down, it’s an engage window with less need to worry about her escaping or stunning you.
Elise.fight: Avoid direct fights early, and engage after both Elise E Cocoon and Elise E Rappel have been used. Use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to move and dodge when Elise engages with Elise Q Venomous Bite or switches to R Spider Form to finish you off. After Elise E Cocoon is used, reduce heavy damage with Master Yi W Meditate, restore health, then follow up with basic attacks.
Elise.phase: Elise is threatening early as she looks to build an advantage through ganks, so Master Yi should focus on farming until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. Master Yi becomes strong in the mid-to-late game, when Master Yi R Highlander lets him get takedowns and he has at least two attack-speed and penetration items. Master Yi becomes weaker again later once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items, so choose engage opportunities carefully.
Elise.watch: At full health, watch out for Elise Q Neurotoxin; after health has decreased, watch out for Elise Q Venomous Bite if Elise switches to R Spider Form. After Elise E Cocoon is used, Master Yi W Meditate can reduce burst damage and restore health.

Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you and pulls Amumu in, potentially setting up Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy. Use jungle monsters as cover to dodge Q Bandage Toss, and avoid grouping with allies if Amumu has R ready.
Amumu.fight: Don’t engage first while Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available. After his crowd control is down, close the gap with Master Yi R Highlander, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and keep attacking. Amumu W Despair deals persistent damage nearby, so fight when you have an angle to finish him instead of staying on him too long.
Amumu.teamfight: Don’t group with allies while Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, and avoid face-to-face fights in narrow passages. Wait out of vision, then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline once Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy have been used. Get involved in the first takedown to reduce Master Yi’s basic ability cooldowns through Master Yi R Highlander, then move to the next target.
Amumu.build: Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage taken, so build armor penetration and use Master Yi E Wuju Style’s true damage. Mix in magic resistance rather than only building health to withstand Amumu’s damage over time. Being caught by Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is deadly, so prioritize tenacity or a crowd-control cleanse as well.
Amumu.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you have a chance to secure the kill. If Amumu’s crowd control is down, go in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If Amumu still has crowd control, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge it. Use Master Yi W Meditate when taking damage after his crowd control has been used.
Amumu.escape: The window to engage opens right after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are used. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to get on him then and follow up with basic attacks. If both crowd-control abilities are still available, save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge them.
Amumu.laning: Master Yi should focus on farming the jungle until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. Gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy’s escape tool is down.
Amumu.phase: Master Yi is strong in the mid-to-late game once he has at least two attack-speed and penetration items, and can chain takedowns with R. His engages become harder once Amumu’s team has both crowd control and defensive items.

Brand.teamfight: Don’t engage first; wait out of vision for immobilizing crowd control such as Brand Q Sear to be used. Spread out from allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm. When an opportunity opens, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach Brand, get involved in the first takedown, then use the reduced cooldowns from Master Yi R Highlander to move to the next target.
Brand.build: Prioritize attack-speed and penetration items to reach your strong mid-to-late game. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Brand’s damage, and don’t rely on stacking health because he deals damage based on maximum health.
Brand.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if needed, then go in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If Blaze is on you and Brand Q Sear is still available, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge the stun. Use Master Yi W Meditate against burst damage, but only after Brand Q Sear has been used.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so your engage window is right after he uses Brand W Pillar of Flame if he remains within range. If Brand Q Sear is down too, there’s less need to worry about being stunned or having Master Yi W Meditate interrupted. Even if Brand Q Sear is available, it won’t stun you if Blaze isn’t on you.
Brand.fight: Close the gap after Brand W Pillar of Flame has been used. If Blaze is on you, dodge Brand Q Sear’s stun first or avoid it with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then follow up with basic attacks.
Brand.laning: Build a lead by farming the jungle instead of forcing ganks early. When ganking Brand’s lane, look for a chance when an ally has applied crowd control or Brand’s poke ability is down. Keep your distance from burning minions, since Brand E Conflagration can spread from them.
Brand.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. Once he has R and starts getting takedowns, he can carry that momentum into the next fight; his strong period is the mid-to-late game, with at least two attack-speed and penetration items. Choose engages more carefully once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Brand.watch: If Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand E Conflagration hits you and applies Blaze, the following Brand Q Sear will stun you if it hits. While Blaze is on you, dodge the Brand Q Sear projectile or hide behind minions; if it’s hard to dodge, avoid it with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. When Brand R Pyroclasm appears, spread out from allies to prevent its bouncing damage.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line explodes as soon as it hits terrain, so do not fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle passage. Graves W Smoke Screen blocks vision and slows you, so leave by the shortest route. Graves P New Destiny's basic attacks are blocked by the first unit hit, so put an ally or minion between you and Graves when possible.
Graves.teamfight: Master Yi should not engage first; wait out of vision for the enemy's immobilizing crowd control to be used. When Graves E Quickdraw and R Collateral Damage are down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and secure the first kill. Get a takedown to refresh Master Yi R Highlander's duration and basic ability cooldowns, then move on to the next target.
Graves.laning: Master Yi should farm the jungle and scale early, avoiding direct fights with Graves. If vision confirms Graves is at a camp on the opposite side, pressure him by stealing his camps. Gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy’s escape ability is down.
Graves.build: Build armor first and get Plated Steelcaps early against Graves' main damage. Armor does not help against the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen, but it is effective against his other main damage.
Graves.combo: Once you choose a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and, if you can go for a kill, Master Yi R Highlander too. Then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow with basic attacks. Weave in Master Yi W Meditate when Graves' burst damage comes in, then resume basic attacks as soon as it ends.
Graves.escape: Do not engage just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. Close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike when Graves R Collateral Damage has not returned and Graves E Quickdraw is down. If Graves W Smoke Screen's slow creates distance, follow with Master Yi R Highlander.
Graves.fight: Look for a chance to retaliate while Graves is reloading after firing two shots. Fight in open terrain, and use Master Yi W Meditate to absorb the heavy damage from Graves Q End of the Line or R Collateral Damage. Once you are on top of him, use basic attacks to reduce Master Yi Q Alpha Strike's cooldown.
Graves.phase: Early on, Master Yi should prioritize farming and generally avoid fights until he learns R. Graves gets stronger as he stacks up, so delay his growth from the start by taking camps along safe routes. In the mid to late game, fight aggressively once Master Yi has at least two attack speed and penetration items, but be more careful about engaging if enemies have both crowd control and defensive items.

LeeSin.teamfight: Wait out of sight until immobilizing crowd control, including Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, has been used. Stand with a wall or your allied frontline behind you to limit Lee Sin's room to get behind you, but leave enough space to avoid colliding with an ally who gets kicked. When you engage, secure a kill on one target so you can carry Master Yi R Highlander's duration and basic ability cooldown benefits to the next target.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and R Dragon's Rage. Armor cannot stop the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. Once you have built up, get attack speed and penetration to reach Master Yi's power spike.
LeeSin.combo: Once you have chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you have a chance to secure a kill. If Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is available, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge it. After Lee Sin's crowd control and mobility are down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in and follow up with basic attacks. Use Master Yi W Meditate when heavy damage is about to hit.
LeeSin.escape: Do not engage just because Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down. The opening to close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike comes when Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is also down and Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike has not yet returned. If Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage has also been used, Master Yi W Meditate is less likely to be interrupted.
LeeSin.fight: Avoid direct duels with Lee Sin in the early jungle. Fight when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down and Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is also down. Once engaged, deal damage with basic attacks enhanced by Master Yi E Wuju Style, and use Master Yi W Meditate to withstand heavy damage after Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage has been used.
LeeSin.laning: Build a lead by farming the jungle early. Enter the enemy jungle only when Lee Sin's position is confirmed at the opposite camp. Try to gank when an ally has applied crowd control or after the enemy has used their mobility and escape abilities.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so Master Yi should focus on jungle farming. After learning Master Yi R Highlander, start fights when you have a reliable chance to secure a kill. Master Yi peaks in the mid to late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items, then becomes weaker again when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage can interrupt Master Yi W Meditate, so save Master Yi W Meditate while Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage is available.

Nocturne.watch: Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror fears you if the tether stays connected, so create distance as soon as it connects to break the tether. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don’t run straight along its trail; turn toward your allies. When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, don’t stay isolated; move to your allies immediately.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, move to your allies first to avoid being isolated. In team fights, wait out of vision until immobilizing crowd control such as Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror has been used. Once a target you can kill appears, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and use Master Yi R Highlander’s kill participation effect to go after the next target.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If Nocturne’s healing feels strong in a particular game, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Nocturne.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander if you have a chance to secure a kill, then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. The duration of your buffs doesn’t decrease during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike or Master Yi W Meditate, so you can activate them before engaging. After Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down, withstand heavy damage with Master Yi W Meditate and resume basic attacking.
Nocturne.escape: If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is also down, engage and fight with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
Nocturne.fight: Early on, farm the jungle rather than meeting Nocturne head-on. In fights, watch your distance so you can break the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror, and respond to Nocturne’s burst with Master Yi W Meditate after the fear has been used. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability, and successfully blocking one greatly increases his attack speed, so choose carefully when to use your abilities while it’s active.
Nocturne.laning: Early on, Master Yi should clear jungle camps quickly to build a lead. Use vision to track Nocturne and only enter the enemy jungle when he is on the opposite side. Try to gank when an ally has already applied crowd control or the enemy has used their escape.
Nocturne.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming over direct fights. After learning Master Yi R Highlander, choose fights where you can participate in kills to keep your growth going. Master Yi is strong in the mid-to-late game after completing at least two attack speed and penetration items, but should be careful again once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.

RekSai.laning: Early on, scale by farming your jungle and avoid fighting Rek'Sai head-on. Secure vision, and only enter the enemy jungle after confirming Rek'Sai is on the opposite side. Walk over visible Rek'Sai Tunnels to destroy them, and gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy's escape ability is down.
RekSai.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai can easily build an advantage through ganks, so Master Yi should avoid fights and focus on farming. After Master Yi gets R Highlander, takedowns let him keep chasing, and the mid and late game is a strong stretch once you have at least two attack speed and penetration items. Don't engage first when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items, as it becomes difficult to engage again.
RekSai.teamfight: Wait out of vision until the enemy's immobilizing crowd control has been used. After Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and take your first target, then look for the next with R Highlander's takedown effect. If there is no opening in a direct standoff, pressure a side lane and wait for the enemy to split up.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek'Sai's main damage. Resistances can't reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and R Void Rush deals damage based on max health, so don't rely on stacking health alone. If the healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items and maintain Grievous Wounds with basic attacks.
RekSai.combo: Once you have a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and also activate R Highlander if you can secure a kill. If Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is already down, close the distance with Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If W is still available, approach on foot, dodge the knock-up with Q, then attack. Use Master Yi W Meditate after the knock-up has been used when you are about to take heavy damage.
RekSai.escape: The opening to engage comes when Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is down and you no longer need to dodge the knock-up. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can escape with R Void Rush, so especially look to follow with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike before R comes back up.
RekSai.fight: If Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is available, don't use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to engage; save it until you can dodge her knock-up. After dodging the knock-up or after Rek'Sai uses it, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and keep basic attacking. Activate R Highlander when you can secure the kill. If Rek'Sai Burrows to heal, keep attacking instead of giving her space.
RekSai.watch: Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow is a guaranteed knock-up, so when you see her Burrowed, move toward open space and use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge the moment she emerges. Also beware of the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and the max-health-based damage from Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Stay close to allies just after Rek'Sai damages you, since she may use R.

Sejuani.teamfight: Don't engage first. Wait out of vision for Sejuani Q Arctic Assault, Sejuani E Permafrost, and Sejuani R Glacial Prison to be used on an ally. Then activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and Master Yi R Highlander, and use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill your first target. When takedowns reduce your basic abilities' cooldowns, move to the next target.
Sejuani.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps quickly to build a growth lead. You can take Sejuani's jungle or objectives to exploit her weak early game, but secure vision so you don't run into her head-on, and move when she is on the opposite side. Gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used an escape.
Sejuani.build: Build attack speed and penetration items to reach your strong mid and late game. Against Sejuani's main damage, start by building magic resistance, but remember it won't block the physical damage from Sejuani W Winter's Wrath. Consider tenacity if Sejuani's crowd control keeps locking you down.
Sejuani.combo: Once you have a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and also activate Master Yi R Highlander if you have a chance to secure a kill. After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, approach with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If all of Sejuani's crowd control has been used, weave Master Yi W Meditate into the fight, then resume basic attacks.
Sejuani.escape: Immediately after you force Sejuani to use Q Arctic Assault is your chance to engage. Once you confirm Sejuani E Permafrost and Sejuani R Glacial Prison have also been used, close in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. If you have already been hit by Sejuani E Permafrost's stun, move away as soon as it wears off to avoid the first basic attack that follows.
Sejuani.fight: Dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison to the side before fighting. You can ignore the slow from Sejuani W Winter's Wrath with Master Yi R Highlander and close the distance. After Sejuani's crowd control has been used, use Master Yi W Meditate to reduce heavy damage and heal.
Sejuani.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming and avoid head-on fights with Sejuani. Your opportunities increase in the mid game, once Master Yi learns R Highlander and can get takedowns. Your strongest stretch is the mid and late game, with at least two attack speed and penetration items. Sejuani's side becomes hard to engage again once it has both crowd control and defensive items.
Sejuani.watch: Dodge the knock-up from Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and the stun from Sejuani R Glacial Prison by moving sideways. If Sejuani W Winter's Wrath hits you with its first strike, get out of range before the second. If attacks from Sejuani and her melee allies build up Sejuani E Permafrost stacks, back away.

Vi.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Wait out of vision for Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist to be used on your allies. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill one target, using Master Yi R Highlander’s cooldown reduction to move on to the next. If there’s no opening in a front-to-front standoff, pressure a side lane and wait for the enemy to split up.
Vi.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, Vi W Denting Blows, and Vi E Relentless Force. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health. Build attack speed and penetration items for Master Yi’s mid-to-late-game damage.
Vi.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander when you have a chance to secure a kill. If Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist are down, go in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If Vi R Cease and Desist is available, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge it as it hits.
Vi.escape: The moment after you dodge or bait out Vi Q Vault Breaker is your chance to close the gap. If both Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist are down, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and fight. Don’t use Master Yi W Meditate first while her crowd control is still available.
Vi.fight: Avoid extended trades while Vi Q Vault Breaker and Vi R Cease and Desist are available. If you have to take Vi’s burst damage, reduce it with Master Yi W Meditate after her crowd control has been used.
Vi.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps quickly to build a lead. Avoid routes that bring you face-to-face with Vi, and only try to counter-jungle after vision confirms she is at a camp on the opposite side. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used their escape.
Vi.phase: Focus on farming and avoid fights with Vi before Master Yi learns R Highlander. After learning R Highlander, look for sure opportunities to participate in kills, and hit your stride in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items. Choose your engages more carefully when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it charges and dashes forward, knocking you back, so move backward or to the side when you see her charging. Vi R Cease and Desist follows its target all the way and knocks them up, so don’t try to dodge it with Flash; look for a chance to avoid it with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike as it hits. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor and increases Vi’s attack speed with repeated hits, so don’t trade for long early on.

Briar.teamfight: Don’t engage first; wait out of vision until Briar uses her immobilizing crowd control on an ally. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline, kill one enemy, and use the abilities that have refreshed from Master Yi R Highlander’s takedown effect to move to the next target. If there’s no opening in a face-to-face standoff, pressure a side lane and wait for the enemy to split up.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush charges and stuns, and also reduces armor, so be ready to avoid it with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike as she comes in. Briar E Chilling Scream stuns targets that hit a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one. If Briar R Certain Death hits you and marks you as prey, move toward your allies and fight together instead of trying to run alone.
Briar.build: Build armor first to withstand Briar’s main damage. If duels drag on because of the healing from Briar P Crimson Curse, W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and E Chilling Scream, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Master Yi can keep applying Grievous Wounds by continuing to use basic attacks.
Briar.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate R Highlander too if you can confidently secure the kill, then follow up with basic attacks. If Briar Q Head Rush is still available, approach on foot and use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to avoid the charge and stun. After Briar’s crowd control has been used, use Master Yi W Meditate mid-fight to reduce damage, then resume attacking with the empowered basic attack as soon as it ends.
Briar.escape: Don’t go in just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death also provide mobility, so wait for her remaining abilities and crowd control to be used. In particular, look for a chance to close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike before Briar R Certain Death returns.
Briar.fight: While Briar’s charge and stun are available, don’t spend Master Yi Q Alpha Strike entirely on engaging; save it to dodge. If Briar tries to create distance with the slow from Briar E Chilling Scream, you can follow with Master Yi R Highlander. When burst damage comes in after Briar’s crowd control has been used, use Master Yi W Meditate to reduce damage and restore health.
Briar.laning: As Master Yi, build a lead by farming the jungle early and avoid direct encounters with Briar. Only counter-jungle after confirming with vision that Briar is at the opposite camp. Gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used their mobility and escape tools.
Briar.phase: Briar often gets involved in kills early, so Master Yi should focus on farming until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. After getting R, he can keep fighting by reducing ability cooldowns through takedowns. Master Yi peaks in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack-speed and penetration items, but it becomes harder to engage once Briar’s team has both crowd control and defensive items.

Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows does not fear several of you at once. Master Yi should not engage first; wait out of vision for Hecarim E Devastating Charge and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows to be used. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill one target, then target the next enemy with Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect.
Hecarim.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. If the healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. The true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style is not reduced by the armor Hecarim W Spirit of Dread grants.
Hecarim.combo: Once you choose a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander if you have a chance to secure the kill. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close the gap and continue with basic attacks. If you need to take burst damage after Hecarim's crowd control is used, reduce the damage and heal with Master Yi W Meditate, then attack again.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so do not rush your engage. In particular, close in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike during the window when Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows has not returned.
Hecarim.fight: Do not close in first for a prolonged fight while Hecarim E Devastating Charge and Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows are available. Once both abilities have been used up, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and, if a kill looks possible, Master Yi R Highlander before engaging.
Hecarim.laning: Master Yi should focus on jungle farming until he learns Master Yi R Highlander and avoid direct fights with Hecarim early. Only try to counterjungle after confirming the enemy jungler's position. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used their escape.
Hecarim.phase: Once Master Yi starts getting takedowns with Master Yi R Highlander, he can chain fights by reducing his basic ability cooldowns. Master Yi peaks in the mid to late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items, but be cautious again when enemies build both crowd control and defensive items.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he has run, so break vision or move toward allies when he creates distance and starts running. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can interrupt your engage with fear, so track whether he has used it. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread heals if you attack him for too long while it is active, so trade briefly or move out of its area.

Kayn.teamfight: Do not engage first; wait out of vision until Kayn W Blade's Reach and other immobilizing crowd control are used. When an opening appears, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and secure a kill, then use the abilities refreshed by Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect to move on to the next target. If there is no opening in a face-off, pressure a side lane and wait for the enemy to split up.
Kayn.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade's Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. If you frequently have duels in which Kayn keeps healing after transforming into his Darkin form, build resistance first, then fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Kayn.combo: Once you choose a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and, if you have a chance to secure the kill, Master Yi R Highlander, then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow with basic attacks. If you need to dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach, save Q for dodging instead of using it to engage.
Kayn.escape: If only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, he can escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass, so do not rush in. If you have dodged Kayn W Blade's Reach and his R has not returned, close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and fight.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach and look for a window before Kayn R Umbral Trespass returns. Once you are on top of him, keep attacking with Master Yi E Wuju Style active. When Kayn's heavy damage is coming in, confirm his crowd control is down, then absorb it with Master Yi W Meditate.
Kayn.laning: Farm the jungle early and avoid direct fights with Kayn. When vision confirms he is on the opposite side, target his jungle or an objective to delay his transformation. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used their escape.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is weak before his early transformation, but Master Yi should still focus on farming and avoid direct fights until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. Once you have R and get takedowns, you can move on to the next target. Master Yi is strong in the mid to late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items. His power falls again when enemies build both crowd control and defensive items.
Kayn.watch: Kayn W Blade's Reach can interrupt Master Yi W Meditate with its slow and knock-up, so dodge the line attack and meditate after W is down. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your max health, and Kayn R Umbral Trespass lets him enter a target he has damaged, giving him a chance to heal and re-engage.

Lillia.laning: In the early game, Master Yi should build a lead by farming the jungle. When Lillia's location is unknown, do not pass through narrow jungle entrances or river corridors where it is difficult to dodge Lillia E Swirlseed. Try to gank when an ally has applied crowd control or Lillia's escape is down, and counter-jungle only after confirming she is on the opposite side.
Lillia.teamfight: Do not engage first. Wait out of sight for threatening crowd control, including Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, to be used. If an ally's immobilizing crowd control hits Lillia as she approaches from the flank, quickly kill her by exploiting her low armor. After participating in the first takedown, use the duration and basic ability cooldown benefits from Master Yi R Highlander to move on to the next target.
Lillia.build: Buy Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough. Build magic resistance first against Lillia's primary damage, and also get armor to withstand basic attacks. Resistances do not apply to the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, and stacking only health also increases the damage from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough.
Lillia.combo: Once you have chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style. If you have a chance to secure a kill, activate Master Yi R Highlander too, then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. Close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is used. Fight where there are no nearby minions or monsters to maximize Master Yi Q Alpha Strike's single-target damage.
Lillia.escape: Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is her only mobility ability, so right after she uses it is an opening to engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. Engage when Lillia keeps missing abilities and has no movement speed stacks. If there is still a risk of falling asleep to Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, first dodge the ability that applies Dream Dust.
Lillia.fight: Fight when Lillia has missed abilities and failed to build stacks of movement speed. If she tries to create distance with the slow from Lillia E Swirlseed, follow with Master Yi R Highlander's slow immunity and movement speed. Move out of the center to dodge the heavy damage from Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, and if you must take burst damage after her crowd control is used, endure it with Master Yi W Meditate.
Lillia.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming and avoid direct fights until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. After learning it, takedowns reduce ability cooldowns and let him keep fighting, and the mid to late game is his strong period once he has at least two attack speed and penetration items. He becomes weaker again when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items, so choose your target carefully before engaging.
Lillia.watch: Being hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or E Swirlseed makes you eligible to be put to sleep by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even if your health is high. When you see the windup for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, move sideways to get out of the center. If you are hit by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, move to a safe place during the drowsy window before you fall asleep.

Nunu.phase: Master Yi is strong in the mid to late game, when he can participate in takedowns with Master Yi R Highlander and has at least two attack speed and penetration items. After the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items, engaging becomes difficult, so do not start fights.
Nunu.teamfight: Wait out of sight until immobilizing crowd control such as Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage has been used on an ally. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, Master Yi has no crowd control to interrupt it, so leave its area. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill one target, and use the extended duration and reduced basic ability cooldowns from Master Yi R Highlander to move on to the next target.
Nunu.build: Fit Executioner's Calling between core items early to reduce healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Build magic resistance against Nunu & Willump's primary damage, and consider tenacity against crowd control.
Nunu.combo: Once you have chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style. If you have a chance to secure a kill, activate Master Yi R Highlander too, then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. The durations of both empowered effects do not decrease while you use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike or Master Yi W Meditate. After Nunu & Willump's immobilizing crowd control is down, use Master Yi W Meditate to absorb damage, then resume basic attacks.
Nunu.escape: The opening to engage comes after the knock-up from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage have been used. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance, so use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in during that window and follow up with basic attacks.
Nunu.fight: Master Yi R Highlander makes you immune to slows, so you can close the gap through the slows from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage and R Absolute Zero. Use Master Yi W Meditate when taking heavy damage, but only when you are not at risk of being interrupted by remaining immobilizing crowd control.
Nunu.laning: Try to gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy's escape is down. Avoid counter-jungling where you could run into Nunu & Willump directly, and enter only after confirming the enemy is at the opposite camp.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! travels a long distance and knocks you up, so when you see it, do not keep running in its direction; walk toward the incoming snowball to escape to the spot where Nunu was just standing. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to leave the area before you are rooted. Leave the area early when Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins.

Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks to gain an advantage through ganks and invades, so Master Yi should keep vision and farm. After Master Yi learns R Highlander, look for fights where you can get takedowns. You become strong in the mid and late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items. If Shaco doesn't get early kills and you buy time, his late game dueling power falls off, but Master Yi also weakens again when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Shaco.build: Early on, bring Control Wards and Oracle Lens to clear Shaco W Jack In The Box. Against Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate, build magic resistance first. Also get enough health to avoid the health threshold where damage from Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison becomes stronger. Magic resistance alone can't block all the physical damage from Shaco Q Deceive and mixed damage from Shaco P Backstab.
Shaco.combo: Once you have a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and also activate Master Yi R Highlander if you can secure a kill. Then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. After Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate's fear have been used, absorb damage with Master Yi W Meditate and resume basic attacks. The durations of Master Yi E Wuju Style and Master Yi R Highlander do not tick down while you use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike or Master Yi W Meditate.
Shaco.escape: The moment Shaco appears with Q Deceive is your chance to kill him, so close the distance with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike then. If Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate's fear are still available, wait to engage and close in during the window after that crowd control has been used.
Shaco.fight: Focus your damage with allies right after Shaco appears with Q Deceive. Counter the slow from Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison with Master Yi R Highlander, and use Master Yi W Meditate to withstand Shaco's burst damage. However, if the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box or Shaco R Hallucinate is still available, it may interrupt Master Yi W Meditate, so use it after the fear has been used.
Shaco.laning: Early on, build by clearing your jungle instead of forcing a head-on fight with Shaco. Keep vision at your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco's early ganks and invades. Time ganks for when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used an escape; otherwise, prepare for objectives.
Shaco.teamfight: Don't engage first. Wait out of vision until Shaco W Jack In The Box and Shaco R Hallucinate's fear have been used. After taking your first target, use the abilities that come back off cooldown through Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect to move to the next target.
Shaco.watch: Watch out for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives. If you think Shaco is nearby, adjust the direction you are facing so he can't get behind you and hit you with the empowered attacks from Shaco P Backstab and Shaco Q Deceive. Shaco R Hallucinate's clone explodes and leaves a box when it dies, so move away immediately if you kill the clone.

Viego.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Wait out of vision until immobilizing crowd control such as Viego W Spectral Maw has been used. When you can secure a kill, activate Master Yi R Highlander, then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the target and carry your kill participation over to the next. Viego can possess a fallen ally with Viego P Sovereign's Domination, so don’t keep fighting near the spot where an ally died.
Viego.escape: Don’t engage immediately just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. The window after Viego R Heartbreaker is also down and before it comes off cooldown is a good time to engage; close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike then.
Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Viego W Spectral Maw. If Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King's healing becomes a problem in extended duels, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Viego.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander if you can go for a kill, then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If Viego W Spectral Maw is available, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge it. After Viego W Spectral Maw is down, withstand damage with Master Yi W Meditate, then land an empowered basic attack as soon as Meditate ends.
Viego.fight: Early on, farm the jungle and build up rather than fighting Viego head-on. In fights, dodge Viego W Spectral Maw to the side and engage after Viego R Heartbreaker is down as well. If Viego W Spectral Maw has been used, withstand heavy damage with Master Yi W Meditate, then resume basic attacking.
Viego.laning: Early on, Master Yi should clear jungle camps quickly to build a lead. Try to gank when an ally has applied crowd control or Viego’s mobility ability has been used. When invading the enemy jungle, use vision to confirm Viego is on the opposite side, and avoid routes where Viego E Harrowed Path is visible.
Viego.phase: Master Yi should focus on farming until he learns Master Yi R Highlander and avoid early fights with Viego. After learning Master Yi R Highlander, participating in kills reduces ability cooldowns and can let you look for consecutive fights. Master Yi peaks in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items, and should fight more carefully once the enemy has crowd control and defensive items.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the longer it charges, so move to the side when you see him charging. Viego R Heartbreaker deals damage based on missing health and targets the champion with the lowest current health, so don’t step forward when your health is low. If you see Viego E Harrowed Path on terrain, Viego may be camouflaged nearby, so avoid that route.

Warwick.escape: If you engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down, he can use his remaining R Infinite Duress to escape. The chance to close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike comes after Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear has been used, especially before R Infinite Duress comes off cooldown after he has used it as well.
Warwick.phase: Early on, direct fights are usually unfavorable for Master Yi, so farm and play to avoid giving Warwick kills. Master Yi starts to come online in the mid game after learning R Highlander, when he can participate in kills; his peak is in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items. Master Yi gets weaker again late in the game if the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Warwick.teamfight: Master Yi shouldn’t engage first. Wait out of vision until crowd control such as Warwick E Primal Howl and R Infinite Duress has been used. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline, kill your first target, and use R Highlander’s kill participation effect to move on to the next. If Warwick suppresses an ally with R Infinite Duress, focus your counterattack on Warwick while he’s held in place.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Armor also helps against the physical damage from his basic attacks. If you have to fight Warwick, who has strong healing, for a long time, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and keep its healing reduction up with basic attacks.
Warwick.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate R Highlander if you can go for a kill, then engage with Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. Master Yi E Wuju Style and R Highlander don’t lose duration during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike or W Meditate, so you can activate them just before engaging. If Warwick E Primal Howl is still available, wait for the fear to come out before engaging in this order.
Warwick.fight: Don’t dump your damage while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; re-engage after the fear. If Warwick E Primal Howl and R Infinite Duress have been used, reduce incoming damage and recover with Master Yi W Meditate, then resume basic attacking. Warwick heals more at low health, so don’t force a finish just because he’s at half health.
Warwick.laning: Early on, Master Yi should focus on building a lead by farming the jungle. If your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your location and makes Warwick faster, so if your health is in a risky range, give up some farming and recall. Even if Warwick clears the jungle slowly, secure vision to avoid meeting him head-on, and invade only after confirming he is at a camp on the opposite side.
Warwick.watch: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and then fears you, so back off. If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits you, you can act while suppressed, so watch for him to engage even from a distance when his movement speed is increased.

Ivern.laning: Farm the jungle early and ward Ivern's jungle to read his route as he returns to harvest camps he seeded. Enter the enemy jungle only after confirming Ivern is alone and checking the nearby vision. Do not force ganks without allied crowd control or an enemy escape being used. Watch for ambushes as you pass by newly created patches of Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.teamfight: Do not engage first; wait out of vision for Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy!'s crowd control to be used. Target one of Ivern's allies affected by Ivern E Triggerseed after the shield bursts, and focus on picking off one of his allies protected by the shield rather than chasing Ivern deep. After getting the first takedown, use the reduced cooldowns from Master Yi R Highlander to move on to the next target.
Ivern.watch: If you are rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern's allies can dash in, so avoid the shot by keeping minions or terrain between you and Ivern. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to avoid being knocked up by its three consecutive attacks. Do not engage a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until its shield bursts.
Ivern.build: Prioritize attack speed and penetration items. Consider magic resistance over armor against Ivern's damage, but prioritize tenacity if Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy! have you crowd controlled while allies attack you.
Ivern.combo: Once you have chosen a target and Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and, if you can reliably secure the kill, Master Yi R Highlander too, then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. If Ivern's crowd control has been used, use Master Yi W Meditate during the fight to withstand damage, then resume basic attacks.
Ivern.escape: The window to engage is immediately after you make Ivern use Ivern Q Rootcaller, his mobility tool and root. Close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike then, but wait until the shield bursts if the target is affected by Ivern E Triggerseed. If Ivern R Daisy!'s knock-up is still available, it can interrupt Master Yi W Meditate, so delay using it.
Ivern.fight: Close the gap just after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, and attack a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed only after its shield bursts. Once you are on top of the target, keep using basic attacks empowered by Master Yi E Wuju Style, and follow with Master Yi R Highlander if a slow creates distance.
Ivern.phase: Master Yi is strong in the mid to late game when he has attack speed and penetration items and can refresh his abilities with takedowns. After that, enemies building both crowd control and defensive items make it harder for him to engage.

Khazix.laning: Master Yi should focus on jungle growth until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. Do not let Kha'Zix read where you are taking camps alone, and secure vision in brushes and jungle entrances. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or Kha'Zix E Leap is down.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in a narrow area with vision to avoid Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear's isolation damage. Master Yi should not engage first; wait out of vision until the enemy's immobilizing crowd control is used. When Kha'Zix E Leap is down or Kha'Zix reappears after Kha'Zix R Void Assault, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to engage and look for the first takedown.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you are isolated, so fight near allies or minions. Ward brushes to prepare for the empowered basic attack and slow from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat; even if you are slowed, you can use Master Yi R Highlander to maintain distance. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay near allies and look for the moment he reappears.
Khazix.build: Build armor first against Kha'Zix's main damage from Q Taste Their Fear, W Void Spike, and E Leap. Armor does not block the magic damage from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat. Then build attack speed and penetration for Master Yi's mid to late game strength.
Khazix.combo: Once you have chosen a target and an angle to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you can secure a kill. After Kha'Zix E Leap is down, close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and continue with basic attacks. When Kha'Zix's burst damage comes in, reduce it with Master Yi W Meditate, then attack again.
Khazix.escape: The window to follow with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is right after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage. If the slow from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat creates distance, answer with Master Yi R Highlander. Do not chase recklessly while Kha'Zix is hidden with Kha'Zix R Void Assault; close in when he reappears.
Khazix.fight: Avoid isolation by staying near allies or minions, and wait until Kha'Zix E Leap is down. If Kha'Zix jumps in, reduce the burst damage with Master Yi W Meditate, then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike right after the leap to get on top of him and continue with basic attacks. When Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay near allies and look for the moment he reappears.
Khazix.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming and avoid direct fights until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. In the mid game, after gaining at least two evolutions, Kha'Zix poses a greater threat to champions acting alone than he does before his first evolution, so move with allies then. Master Yi is strong in the mid to late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items, but weakens again when enemies build both crowd control and defensive items.

Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out from allies so you don't overlap with the path of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent or the area damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis and Shyvana E Molten Burst. Master Yi shouldn't engage first; wait out of vision for the moment to enter, then join with Master Yi R Highlander and Master Yi Q Alpha Strike when you can secure a kill. Move to the next target after takedowns reduce your basic abilities' cooldowns.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, and also build armor against her basic attack damage. If the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis feels strong, fit Executioner's Calling between core items and maintain Grievous Wounds with basic attacks.
Shyvana.combo: Once you have a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and also activate Master Yi R Highlander if you have a chance to secure the kill. Then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. The durations of these buffs don't tick down while you use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike or Master Yi W Meditate, so don't delay your basic attacks by activating them after engaging. Weave Master Yi W Meditate in when Shyvana's heavy damage hits, then resume basic attacks.
Shyvana.escape: After Shyvana uses R Dragon's Descent, she has no way to create distance on her own, so use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in when an opening appears. Shyvana is also vulnerable to pressure when her Fury bar is empty and she can't transform.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana's scaling before Shyvana P Scalemail stacks up, but avoid Master Yi's early head-on fights. When fighting, use Master Yi R Highlander to close in through the slow from Shyvana E Molten Burst, and use Master Yi W Meditate when Shyvana's burst damage hits. Shyvana's return to human form after her transformation ends is also a chance to counterattack.
Shyvana.laning: Early on, clear your jungle quickly to build a growth lead. Use vision to locate Shyvana, then take camps on the opposite side or prepare for an objective. It's important to delay Shyvana P Scalemail's permanent stacks, but avoid invades where you might run into her head-on. Gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy's escape is down.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, Master Yi should farm and focus on slowing Shyvana's camp and objective growth. Once Master Yi gets R Highlander and starts getting takedowns, he can keep fighting. His peak is the mid and late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items. However, Shyvana P Scalemail's stacks are permanent, so this matchup becomes more unfavorable as time passes.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana E Molten Burst slows and deals damage based on max health, so be careful not to let her create distance after it hits you. Shyvana R Dragon's Descent dashes and attacks in an area, and she is unstoppable while flying, so move out of its path and respond after she lands. Shyvana Q Emberstrike also deals true damage, so don't rely on resistances to stay in a prolonged fight.

MonkeyKing.teamfight: While Wukong R Cyclone is ready, keep your distance from allies and do not engage first. Wait out of sight until Wukong R Cyclone has been used, then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline. Kill the first target to reduce ability cooldowns with Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect, then move on to the next target.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first to withstand Wukong's primary damage. However, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor and Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, so armor alone cannot stop all his damage. If healing from Wukong P Stone Skin becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
MonkeyKing.combo: Once you have chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and activate Master Yi R Highlander if you have a chance to secure a kill. If Wukong still has crowd control available, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. Once Wukong R Cyclone and his escape are down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in and follow up with basic attacks. Use Master Yi W Meditate against the heavy damage that follows.
MonkeyKing.escape: Do not engage just because Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down. The opening comes when Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down and Wukong W Warrior Trickster has not yet returned. Once Wukong R Cyclone is down too, you can close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike without risking a knock-up.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin stacks armor and healing the longer a fight lasts, so take short trades early. Do not waste attacks on the stationary clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster; watch which way the real Wukong escapes.
MonkeyKing.laning: In the early game, Master Yi should build a lead by farming the jungle. Avoid direct fights with Wukong, and try to counter-jungle only after confirming with vision that Wukong is at a camp on the opposite side. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or Wukong has used his escape.
MonkeyKing.phase: Master Yi should focus on farming and avoid fights until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. Afterward, takedowns reduce his ability cooldowns, letting him go after another target. His strong period is the mid to late game, once he has at least two attack speed and penetration items, but fighting becomes difficult again when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted ability, so avoid it by staying out of range. If it hits and Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, the attacks that follow become dangerous. Wukong R Cyclone knocks you up, deals damage based on your maximum health, and can be used again, so create distance while accounting for his clone.

Poppy.teamfight: Don't engage first. Wait out of vision for Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict to be used on an ally. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends too, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill your first target, then move to the next with Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect. If there is no opening in a direct standoff, pressure a side lane and look for a moment when the enemy splits up.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Rather than spending resources on magic resistance for Poppy alone, build attack speed and penetration for the mid and late game.
Poppy.combo: Once you have a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends. If you can secure a kill, also activate Master Yi R Highlander, then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If you need to dodge Poppy E Heroic Charge or Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to evade them. After both crowd control abilities have been used, use Master Yi W Meditate to withstand damage, then resume basic attacks.
Poppy.escape: Right after Poppy E Heroic Charge has been used is your chance to close the distance. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. Near walls, move into open space to avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Poppy R Keeper's Verdict is still available, wait for that crowd control to be used before casting Master Yi W Meditate.
Poppy.fight: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, close the distance on foot and engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike after it ends. Counter the slow from Poppy Q Hammer Shock with Master Yi R Highlander's slow immunity, and use attacks with Master Yi E Wuju Style active to deal true damage to Poppy's high armor. Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict can interrupt Master Yi W Meditate, so use it after both abilities have been used.
Poppy.laning: Early on, build a growth lead by clearing your jungle instead of forcing a head-on fight. Look to gank when an ally has applied crowd control or Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Before counterjungling where you might run into Poppy, check her position with vision.
Poppy.phase: Before Master Yi learns R Highlander, focus on farming and avoid early head-on fights with Poppy. Once R Highlander lets you get takedowns, you can look for consecutive fights. Your strong stretch is the mid and late game, when you have at least two attack speed and penetration items. Later, choose your engage more carefully once Poppy has crowd control and defensive items.
Poppy.watch: Stand in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can't stun you against a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you the first time, walk out of its area before the second blast. When you see Poppy charging R Keeper's Verdict, move to the side instead of staying in front of her.

Rengar.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps to scale and avoid head-on encounters with Rengar. When Rengar is missing, avoid paths beside bushes and use a Control Ward to secure vision of them. Only counterjungle after confirming the enemy is at camps on the opposite side.
Rengar.watch: When Rengar's Ferocity is full, Rengar E Bola Strike roots instead of slowing. Avoid trading when Rengar's resource bar is full, and use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike after Rengar E Bola Strike has been spent. When Rengar approaches with R Thrill of the Hunt, don't stay alone while injured; stay with allies and within vision.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar's main damage. Keep in mind that the armor you build is less effective while Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt reduces your resistances. If the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items and maintain Grievous Wounds with basic attacks.
Rengar.combo: Once you have a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and also activate Master Yi R Highlander if you can secure a kill. After dodging Rengar E Bola Strike, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If Rengar's burst damage lands, absorb it with Master Yi W Meditate, then resume basic attacks.
Rengar.escape: Engage when Rengar E Bola Strike is down and Rengar has no Ferocity. Rengar has no ability to create distance on his own, so use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in during this window. While Rengar E Bola Strike can be empowered to root, don't engage relying only on Master Yi R Highlander's slow immunity.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar has no Ferocity and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. If you dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, close in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If you need to take Rengar's burst damage, use Master Yi W Meditate after Rengar E Bola Strike has been used to reduce it.
Rengar.phase: Before Master Yi learns R Highlander, focus on farming and avoid fights. Afterward, activate Master Yi R Highlander when you can get a takedown and look for a chance to move to the next target. You are strong in the mid and late game once you have at least two attack speed and penetration items, but fight cautiously again if the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Rengar.teamfight: Don't engage first. Wait out of vision until Rengar E Bola Strike has been used. After you withstand Rengar's engage, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in when Rengar W Battle Roar is down and you can take your first target. On a takedown, use Master Yi R Highlander's effect to reduce your basic abilities' cooldowns and move to the next target.

Skarner.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Wait out of vision for Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale to be used on your allies. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill one target, using Master Yi R Highlander’s kill participation effect to move on to the next. Near the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit, avoid standing against a wall because Skarner R Impale can pull you in.
Skarner.build: Decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar against Skarner R Impale. If you build resistances, prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Given Skarner’s damage based on your maximum health, avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Skarner.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander if you have a chance to secure a kill. After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and Skarner R Impale are down, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. When you’re about to take heavy damage during a fight, withstand it with Master Yi W Meditate, then resume basic attacking after the channel finishes, once the crowd control has been used.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is a key way for him to move, so the moment after you bait it out is your chance to close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. However, if Skarner E Ixtal's Impact hits a wall, its cooldown is greatly reduced, so back off with his next dash in mind. If Skarner R Impale is available, don’t engage first; wait until the suppression has been used.
Skarner.fight: Stay in open space away from walls until Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. Once the dash is down, approach with Master Yi R Highlander to avoid being slowed, and deal damage with basic attacks while Master Yi E Wuju Style is active. After all of Skarner’s crowd control has been used, use Master Yi W Meditate to withstand heavy damage, then resume basic attacking.
Skarner.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps quickly to grow, and avoid direct fights with Skarner. When vision confirms Skarner is on the opposite side, steal enemy jungle camps or prepare for an objective. Try to gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used their escape.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming and avoid direct fights with Skarner, who has crowd control. After Master Yi learns R Highlander and starts participating in kills, he can keep fighting by reducing his ability cooldowns. Master Yi is strong in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items, but engaging becomes difficult again once Skarner has defensive items and crowd control.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns you if you hit a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. Skarner R Impale’s suppression can’t be removed with a movement ability, so don’t try to escape with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike after being caught. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid positions where you keep taking empowered basic attacks.

Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage, so build armor first if you add resistances. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet heals her, so fit Executioner's Calling between core items and keep its healing reduction up with basic attacks. You can’t reduce the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet with resistances, so you need to withstand it with your total health.
Belveth.teamfight: Don’t engage first. Wait out of vision until immobilizing crowd control, including Bel'Veth W Above and Below, has been used. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill one target, using Master Yi R Highlander’s kill participation effect to go after the next. If a Void Coral appears where an ally died, back off before Bel'Veth collects it, and delay team fights while Bel'Veth is transformed.
Belveth.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander if you have a chance to secure a kill. After Bel'Veth W Above and Below is down and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If you have to take heavy damage, withstand it with Master Yi W Meditate, then resume basic attacks.
Belveth.escape: Don’t engage immediately just because Bel'Veth has used Q Void Surge alone. Dodging Bel'Veth W Above and Below also prevents her dash cooldown from resetting, so after dodging it, close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike before Bel'Veth Q Void Surge comes off cooldown. When choosing your path, use the fact that Bel'Veth can’t immediately dash again in the direction she just dashed in.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side and resume basic attacks after Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends. Withstand Bel'Veth’s heavy damage with Master Yi W Meditate, but use it after Bel'Veth W Above and Below has been used so it won’t be interrupted. Activate Master Yi R Highlander when you can reliably go for a kill.
Belveth.laning: Early on, Master Yi should clear the jungle quickly to build a lead. It’s best to take camps before Bel'Veth builds stacks, but avoid meeting her head-on and only invade after vision confirms she is at the camps on the opposite side. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or Bel'Veth has exhausted her mobility abilities.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth is weak early, but Master Yi should also focus on farming until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. In the mid-to-late game, once Master Yi has at least two attack speed and penetration items, he can keep fights going through kill participation. Bel'Veth gains permanent stacks and grows stronger over time, so slow her growth early.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below slows and knocks you up, and also resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge’s cooldown, so move to the side when she engages. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces her damage taken, so don’t dump your attacks into it; wait for it to end. When your health is low, watch out for Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom and Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet, which deal damage based on missing health.

Evelynn.watch: If the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, move back into allied vision before she charms you. When your health is low, don’t stay somewhere without vision where Evelynn R Last Caress can finish you off.
Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Evelynn’s main damage. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance and Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on maximum health, so prioritize backing off before the mark matures instead of stacking health. If the healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items and keep Grievous Wounds applied with basic attacks.
Evelynn.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too when you have a chance to secure the kill. Then go in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If Evelynn W Allure is still a threat, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge it. After the charm is used, time Master Yi W Meditate against Evelynn’s burst damage, then resume basic attacks.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t engage just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down, since Evelynn R Last Caress can also let her escape. A good engage window is after Evelynn W Allure’s charm is used and before Evelynn R Last Caress returns. Close the gap then with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
Evelynn.fight: Keep your distance before the mark from Evelynn W Allure matures, and engage after the charm is used. Use Master Yi W Meditate to withstand Evelynn’s burst, but wait until the charm has been used so it can’t interrupt you. If Evelynn R Last Caress is down too, that’s a chance to close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
Evelynn.laning: Master Yi should build a lead by farming the jungle early. Ward near the camps where Evelynn might start a fight, and alert your allies immediately if you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure.
Evelynn.phase: After Master Yi learns Master Yi R Highlander, getting takedowns makes it easier to carry momentum into the next fight. Master Yi peaks in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack-speed and penetration items, but be careful again once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Evelynn.teamfight: Don’t engage first; wait out of vision for the charm from Evelynn W Allure to be used. After getting involved in the first takedown, use the effect of Master Yi R Highlander to reduce basic ability cooldowns and move to the next target.

Nidalee.phase: Master Yi is better off farming to scale early, and the available information is not enough to determine who is stronger in the early game between him and Nidalee. After learning Master Yi R Highlander, takedowns reduce ability cooldowns and let him keep fighting. Master Yi peaks in the mid to late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items, then becomes weaker again when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so sidestep its path. Be careful around rivers and jungle entrances where Nidalee W Bushwhack may be waiting. If a spear or trap marks you, save Master Yi W Meditate to prepare for Nidalee Q Takedown after Nidalee W Pounce.
Nidalee.build: The available information is not enough to determine the first item. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Nidalee's damage. If healing from Nidalee E Primal Surge becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Nidalee.combo: Once you have chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you have a chance to secure a kill. After Nidalee W Pounce is down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in and follow up with basic attacks. If Nidalee pounces first and deals burst damage, absorb it with Master Yi W Meditate, then attack.
Nidalee.escape: Nidalee W Pounce is her only mobility ability, so right after she uses it is an opening to engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. Nidalee has no crowd control, but if you are marked after being hit by a spear or trap, engage carefully and watch for Pounce and Q Takedown.
Nidalee.fight: After dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and W Bushwhack, close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike the moment Nidalee W Pounce is used. If Nidalee pounces on you while you are marked, time Master Yi W Meditate to absorb the burst damage that follows, then resume basic attacks when it ends.
Nidalee.laning: Farm the jungle early and avoid direct encounters with Nidalee. Check river and jungle entrances for traps with a Control Ward or an area ability, and try to enter the enemy jungle only after confirming Nidalee is at the opposite camp. Time ganks for when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used a mobility ability.
Nidalee.teamfight: Do not engage first. Wait out of sight and watch where Nidalee emerges to throw a spear and whether Nidalee W Pounce has been used. After Pounce is down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close in and take the first target, then use the reduced ability cooldowns from Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect to move on to the next.
