Rammus.laning: In the early game, farm jungle camps and avoid running into Rammus directly. Try to counter-jungle only after confirming the enemy's location. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy's escape is down.
Rammus.teamfight: Do not engage first. Wait out of sight until Rammus Q Powerball, E Frenzying Taunt, and R Soaring Slam have been used on an ally. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill one target, followed by another using Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, do not focus your basic attacks on him.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. Then build attack speed and penetration, but do not basic attack while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, since you will take reflected damage.
Rammus.combo: Once you have chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander if you have a chance to secure a kill. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is still available, save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge it and approach on foot.
Rammus.escape: However, if Rammus Q Powerball and E Frenzying Taunt are still available, do not engage first; wait until the crowd control has been used.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop basic attacking and back away or attack another target. Once W ends and his taunt is down, attack with basic attacks empowered by the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style. When Rammus's heavy damage is coming, use Master Yi W Meditate to absorb it after the crowd control has been used.
Rammus.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming, since fighting Rammus through his crowd control is usually unfavorable. Opportunities open up from mid game, when Master Yi has R Highlander and can participate in takedowns. His strong period is the mid to late game, once he has at least two attack speed and penetration items. In the late game, engaging becomes difficult again once Rammus has both crowd control and defensive items.
Rammus.watch: When Rammus Q Powerball rolls toward you, put a minion between you and it to avoid the collision. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt catches you, you cannot move or use abilities, so wait out of range. Rammus R Soaring Slam has a larger area after he rolls in quickly, so move well away and leave the landing spot too.

Taliyah.teamfight: Don't engage first. Wait out of vision for immobilizing crowd control like Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth to be used. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill one target, and look for the next with Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect. If there's no opening in a direct standoff, pressure a side lane and wait for the enemy to split up.
Taliyah.build: Increase your basic attack damage with attack speed and penetration items. If the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is a problem, build magic resistance first.
Taliyah.combo: Once you have a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and also activate Master Yi R Highlander if you can secure a kill. From an angle that avoids the minefield from Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. After Taliyah's crowd control is down, if her burst damage hits, absorb it with Master Yi W Meditate and resume basic attacks.
Taliyah.escape: Engage after Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are down. If Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is down too, that's a good window to chase. If you haven't damaged Taliyah yet, account for her being able to escape using her wall when choosing your engage angle.
Taliyah.fight: Avoid the area covered by Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and close in on foot. Engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike after Taliyah's crowd control has been used. Dodge Taliyah Q Threaded Volley to the side, and if you need to take burst damage, withstand it with Master Yi W Meditate after her crowd control has been used.
Taliyah.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps quickly to scale instead of forcing ganks. Gank when an ally has applied crowd control or Taliyah has used her escape. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, be ready to retreat because she may intervene in another lane.
Taliyah.phase: Until Master Yi learns Master Yi R Highlander, focus on farming and avoid early fights. Afterward, start fighting when you can get takedowns. Your peak is the mid and late game, once you have at least two attack speed and penetration items. Engage more cautiously again when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Taliyah.watch: Don't engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike over the minefield. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can't change direction while firing, so dodge to the side.

XinZhao.teamfight: Master Yi shouldn’t engage first. Wait out of vision for Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and the crowd control from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard to be used. When Xin Zhao dives in, avoid standing too close to your allies so R Crescent Guard’s knockback is less likely to split up your formation. When an opening appears, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill the first target, then use Master Yi R Highlander’s kill participation effect to go after the next.
XinZhao.build: Build armor first against Xin Zhao’s main sources of damage. If the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items and keep its healing reduction up with Master Yi’s repeated basic attacks.
XinZhao.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander if you can reliably go for a kill. After Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks, but use Q to dodge if the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike is imminent. After Xin Zhao’s crowd control has been used, weave in Master Yi W Meditate and resume basic attacks.
XinZhao.escape: Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is his way to move, so the moment after you bait it out is your chance to close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. Once the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike and the forced movement from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard are also down, there’s less risk of Master Yi W Meditate being interrupted.
XinZhao.fight: Early on, don’t fight Xin Zhao head-on. When fighting, dodge Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to the side, and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike for the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike. After Xin Zhao’s crowd control is down, reduce damage and recover with Master Yi W Meditate, then attack with the basic attacks that follow.
XinZhao.laning: Early on, Master Yi should build a lead by farming the jungle. Avoid routes that bring you face-to-face with Xin Zhao, and only try to counter-jungle after vision confirms Xin Zhao is at a camp on the opposite side. Try to gank when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy’s movement and escape abilities are down.
XinZhao.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming and avoid fights with Xin Zhao. After learning Master Yi R Highlander, he can use kill participation to keep moving into the next fight, and he is strong in the mid-to-late game after completing at least two attack speed and penetration items. Later in the game, Master Yi gets weaker again once the enemy has crowd control and defensive items, so use the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends as a chance to counterattack.

Jax.laning: Farm the jungle early and avoid direct fights with Jax. Get involved when an ally has applied crowd control or Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down. Without those conditions, spend your time farming the jungle or preparing for objectives instead of ganking.
Jax.build: Set a goal of getting at least two attack speed and penetration items first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance when building resistances.
Jax.combo: Once you have chosen a target and Jax E Counter Strike is down, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and, if you have a sure chance to secure the kill, Master Yi R Highlander. Immediately after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and continue basic attacks. If Jax E Counter Strike's stun has already been used, weave in Master Yi W Meditate during the fight to reduce damage and heal.
Jax.escape: Jax Q Leap Strike is his only mobility tool, so the moment after he uses it is your chance to close the gap. However, if Jax E Counter Strike is still available, first move outside the stun radius and wait for it to expire. Engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike during the window when both abilities are down.
Jax.fight: When Jax E Counter Strike activates, stop basic attacking and wait outside the stun radius for it to end. Once Jax E Counter Strike is down and Jax Q Leap Strike has also been used, close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and continue basic attacks. After Jax E Counter Strike's stun is used, weave in Master Yi W Meditate to reduce incoming heavy damage and heal.
Jax.phase: Master Yi is strong in the mid to late game once he has at least two attack speed and penetration items, but becomes harder to fight with again when enemies build both crowd control and defensive items.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, spread out so you are not hit by its area stun together, and do not engage first. Once Jax E Counter Strike is down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike from out of vision to reach the backline and kill the first target. After a takedown grants the duration and basic ability cooldown benefits from Master Yi R Highlander, move on to the next target.
Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, it dodges basic attacks and their bonus damage, so stop basic attacking and move outside the stun radius. Jax can close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike, so do not use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to engage before Jax E Counter Strike expires.

Kindred.teamfight: Do not engage first. Wait out of sight until the enemy's immobilizing crowd control has been used, then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter the zone to survive and do not expect to secure a kill inside it. After the zone ends, take the first target and use Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect to continue to the next.
Kindred.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and E Mounting Dread. If duels drag on because of Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and R Lamb's Respite, fit Executioner's Calling between core items to keep Grievous Wounds applied with basic attacks.
Kindred.combo: Once you have chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style. If you see a chance to secure a kill, activate Master Yi R Highlander too, then engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. Use Master Yi W Meditate to endure Kindred's heavy damage, then resume attacking with an empowered basic attack as soon as it ends.
Kindred.escape: Do not rush in when only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, since Kindred can escape with W Wolf's Frenzy. Close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike after both mobility abilities are down, especially before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up. If the slow from Kindred E Mounting Dread is a problem, use Master Yi R Highlander to engage.
Kindred.fight: Avoid direct fights early and engage only after both Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and W Wolf's Frenzy are down. Counter the slow from Kindred E Mounting Dread with Master Yi R Highlander, and use Master Yi W Meditate to endure heavy damage.
Kindred.laning: In the early game, Master Yi should farm the jungle and avoid facing Kindred directly. Clear camps marked by Kindred P Mark of the Kindred first, or secure vision nearby to delay Kindred from claiming the mark. Try to counter-jungle only after confirming the enemy is at a camp on the opposite side.
Kindred.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming and avoid direct fights, but he can use vision to interfere with Kindred claiming P Mark of the Kindred. After learning Master Yi R Highlander, look for reliable kill opportunities. Master Yi is strong in the mid to late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items. Fighting becomes difficult again once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Kindred.watch: If you keep taking hits after Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, it deals heavy damage based on your missing health, so create distance or break line of sight when your health is low. Kindred can keep creating distance with Q Dance of Arrows in the area of W Wolf's Frenzy, so do not chase recklessly inside it.

Udyr.laning: Early on, avoid head-on encounters with Udyr and build by clearing your jungle. Use vision at key routes and jungle entrances to track Udyr, and only counterjungle after confirming he is at camps on the opposite side. Time ganks for when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used an escape.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's main damage, but remember that armor alone can't block all the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and mixed damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Udyr.combo: Once you have a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and also activate Master Yi R Highlander if you can secure a kill, then approach. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun is available, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike at the moment the stun would hit, then follow up with basic attacks.
Udyr.escape: Immediately after you force Udyr to use E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. After you take Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun once, he can't apply it to the same target again for a while, so counterattack or escape during that time. Udyr chases quickly, so don't try to run on foot; save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
Udyr.fight: If Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun is ready, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to evade it. After dodging or taking the stun once, pressure him with basic attacks while Master Yi E Wuju Style is active. Don't give Udyr a chance to heal once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone.
Udyr.phase: Master Yi is weak in head-on fights early, so farm instead of fighting Udyr. After learning Master Yi R Highlander, choose fights where you can get takedowns. He comes into his own in the mid and late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items. Choose your engages more carefully when the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Udyr.teamfight: Wait out of vision until Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun is used on an ally. Rather than hitting Udyr first while he tanks with defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and kill a weaker target. After takedowns refresh Master Yi R Highlander's duration and your basic abilities' cooldowns, move to the next target.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede dashes and stuns the first target it hits, so be careful approaching right after he switches to that stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on max health, and you can ignore the slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm with Master Yi R Highlander.

Diana.build: Prioritize attack-speed and penetration items to prepare for your strong mid-to-late game. If you build resistance against Diana, choose magic resistance.
Diana.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you have a chance to secure the kill. When Diana E Lunar Rush is down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to get on her and follow up with basic attacks. After Diana R Moonfall is used, use Master Yi W Meditate to absorb the burst damage.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without marking you with Q Crescent Strike, the moment E is used is a chance to get on her with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. If she hits you with the mark first, E may reset, so don’t chase; create distance. Once Diana R Moonfall is down too, you can use Master Yi W Meditate without worrying about it being interrupted.
Diana.fight: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike and fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear. If Diana E Lunar Rush is used without resetting, close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. After Diana R Moonfall has been used, Master Yi W Meditate can reduce the burst damage and restore health.
Diana.phase: Once Master Yi learns Master Yi R Highlander and can get takedowns, he can carry an advantage into the next target. His strong period is the mid-to-late game, when he has at least two attack-speed and penetration items. Engage carefully again once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Diana.teamfight: Diana R Moonfall deals more damage the more enemies it pulls in, so spread out from allies and watch for flanks. Wait out of vision for immobilizing crowd control such as Diana R Moonfall to be used, then reach the backline with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. Take down the first target to benefit from Master Yi R Highlander’s duration extension and basic ability cooldown reduction, then move to the next target.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves through the air and applies a mark, so dodge sideways. If it hits, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so create distance. After Diana W Pale Cascade is activated, don’t engage until its shield and orbs disappear. Hold onto Master Yi W Meditate until Diana R Moonfall has been used.

Ekko.build: Build an attack-speed and penetration core, but fit Executioner's Calling between core items if the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak is a problem. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand damage from Ekko P Z-Drive Resonance and Ekko Q Timewinder, among other sources.
Ekko.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you have a chance to secure the kill. Then go in with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. After Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun is down, use Master Yi W Meditate to withstand the burst damage, then resume basic attacks.
Ekko.escape: Don’t go in just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. Dodge Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun, then close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike during the window when Ekko E Phase Dive has been used and Ekko R Chronobreak hasn’t returned yet.
Ekko.fight: Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun zone and fight after Ekko R Chronobreak is down. If Ekko Q Timewinder slows you to create distance, follow with Master Yi R Highlander. Use Master Yi W Meditate to absorb Ekko’s burst after the stun is down.
Ekko.laning: Build a lead by farming the jungle instead of forcing fights early. Gank when an ally has applied crowd control or Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko R Chronobreak have been used. Avoid direct encounters with the enemy jungler.
Ekko.phase: Master Yi should focus on farming until he learns Master Yi R Highlander; early fights are usually a losing trade. Once he has R and starts getting takedowns, he becomes stronger at chaining fights, peaking in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack-speed and penetration items. Engage carefully again once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Ekko.teamfight: Don’t engage first; wait out of vision for immobilizing crowd control, including Ekko W Parallel Convergence, to be used. When Ekko R Chronobreak is down, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and get involved in the first takedown. Then use Master Yi R Highlander’s extended duration and the reduced ability cooldowns to move to the next target.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the area. If you stay inside, you’ll be stunned and Ekko will gain a shield. Also move away from the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder.

Fiddlesticks.build: Buy Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest. Magic resistance is the resistance stat to build against Fiddlesticks' damage. If Terrify and the silence make it hard to escape the area, prioritize tenacity over magic resistance.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Once you choose a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you have a chance to secure the kill. If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is already down, engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow with basic attacks. If Terrify is still available, walk up, use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge it, then continue attacking.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Once Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down too, there is less risk of Master Yi W Meditate being interrupted.
Fiddlesticks.fight: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is still available, walk up and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge it as it comes in. Answer the slow from Fiddlesticks E Reap with Master Yi R Highlander. Once Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is down, you can use Master Yi W Meditate to withstand heavy damage and heal.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Farm the jungle early to build a lead. Avoid counterjungling when you might run into Fiddlesticks, and only invade after vision confirms he is on the other side of the map. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or the enemy has used their escape.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Master Yi should focus on farming and generally avoid early fights until he learns Master Yi R Highlander. After learning his ultimate, look for windows when Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, then get takedowns to move on to the next target. Master Yi peaks in the mid to late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items, then weakens again when enemies build both crowd control and defensive items.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Secure vision in the brushes and approaches around objectives, and spread out to guard against Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm's area engage. Master Yi should not engage first; wait out of vision until Fiddlesticks Q Terrify is used. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline, kill the first target, and move to the next with Master Yi R Highlander's takedown effect.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channels before moving and dealing area damage, so move outside its landing area when you see it cast. If Fiddlesticks has been out of vision for a while, expect an ambush from a brush and avoid entering narrow paths without vision. Be especially careful about being hit by the ultimate while constrained by both Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap.

Gragas.build: Build attack speed and penetration to deal with Gragas’s high armor, and use Master Yi E Wuju Style’s true damage, which isn’t reduced by armor. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Gragas’s damage. If the healing from Gragas P Happy Hour is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Gragas.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you can confidently secure the kill. When Gragas E Body Slam is down, approach with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. If Gragas E Body Slam or R Explosive Cask is still available, approach on foot and save Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to dodge.
Gragas.escape: The window to close the gap opens immediately after you make Gragas use E Body Slam. Gragas E Body Slam’s cooldown is greatly reduced if it hits an enemy, so only chase Gragas deep when you can be sure of getting the kill. If both Gragas E Body Slam and R Explosive Cask are down, there’s less risk of Master Yi W Meditate being interrupted.
Gragas.fight: While Gragas W Drunken Rage is reducing the damage he takes, don’t commit your burst; wait for the effect to end. Use Master Yi R Highlander to withstand the slow from Gragas Q Barrel Roll and close the gap. After Gragas E Body Slam and R Explosive Cask are down, Master Yi W Meditate can reduce burst damage and restore health.
Gragas.laning: Build a lead by farming the jungle early. Avoid direct fights where Gragas E Body Slam is available, and plan your route after checking his position with vision. Gank when an ally has applied crowd control or Gragas E Body Slam is down.
Gragas.phase: Master Yi should focus on farming until he learns Master Yi R Highlander, while watching out for Gragas’s early-to-mid-game burst and ability to disrupt the formation. After getting Master Yi R Highlander, look for fights where you can get takedowns. Master Yi becomes strong in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack-speed and penetration items, but fight carefully again once the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Gragas.teamfight: Wait out of vision until Gragas E Body Slam and R Explosive Cask are used on an ally. Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and take down one target, and use the abilities that have refreshed from Master Yi R Highlander’s takedown effect to move to the next. Pressure a side lane to catch the enemy splitting up rather than taking a face-to-face fight in a narrow passage.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius immediately. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near the barrel, you can be knocked up and hit by Gragas R Explosive Cask as well, so keep your distance. Position yourself so Gragas R Explosive Cask doesn’t knock you into the enemy team.

JarvanIV.build: Build attack speed and penetration items to increase Master Yi's damage in the mid to late game.
JarvanIV.combo: Once you choose a target to engage, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style first, and activate Master Yi R Highlander too if you can follow through with a kill.
JarvanIV.escape: Then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to close the gap.
JarvanIV.laning: Look for ganks when an ally's crowd control has landed or the enemy's mobility ability is down.
JarvanIV.teamfight: When an opportunity appears, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style and R Highlander, then use Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline and secure a kill. If takedowns reduce your basic ability cooldowns, move on to the next target.

Zac.build: As you build attack speed and penetration items, fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Zac P Cell Division. Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you build resistances. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Zac.combo: Once you’ve chosen a target, activate Master Yi E Wuju Style, and activate Master Yi R Highlander when you have a chance to secure a kill. Use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to engage in the opening after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, then follow up with basic attacks. When heavy damage comes in after Zac Q Stretching Strikes and E Elastic Slingshot have been used, withstand it with Master Yi W Meditate.
Zac.escape: The moment after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down is your chance to engage with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. If the knockups from Zac Q Stretching Strikes and E Elastic Slingshot are still available, they can interrupt Master Yi W Meditate, so check whether he has used both before engaging. If Zac tries to create distance with a slow, Master Yi R Highlander can let you keep up.
Zac.fight: After Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, close the gap with Master Yi Q Alpha Strike and follow up with basic attacks. Walk over the pieces of Zac’s body that he leaves behind to stop him from healing.
Zac.laning: Early on, farm the jungle and avoid direct fights with Zac. Try to counter-jungle when vision confirms Zac is at a camp on the opposite side. Look for ganks when an ally has applied crowd control or Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down.
Zac.phase: Early on, Master Yi should focus on farming and avoid fights with Zac, who has crowd control. After learning Master Yi R Highlander, he can reduce ability cooldowns through kill participation and move on to the next target. Master Yi peaks in the mid-to-late game with at least two attack speed and penetration items, but gets weaker again if the enemy has both crowd control and defensive items.
Zac.teamfight: Wait out of vision until the knockups from Zac E Elastic Slingshot and Q Stretching Strikes have been used. After absorbing his engage, create distance so you don’t keep taking damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, then use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike to reach the backline when an opening appears. Kill the first target and use Master Yi R Highlander’s kill participation effect to move on to the next.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot is a charge-up dash that knocks enemies up, so move away from the landing area when you see him charging. Zac Q Stretching Strikes also knocks you up, so use Master Yi W Meditate after the crowd control from both abilities is down. Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long.
